strength.excerpt: It does not establish that every exposed reef bleached or died.
strength.reason: This caveat clearly distinguishes heat-stress exposure from observed bleaching or mortality.

weakness.excerpt: The recorded footprint exceeded the 68.2% of global reef area affected by bleaching-level heat stress during the 2014–2017 event.
weakness.reason: The comparison establishes a record, but the article offers little context about ecological consequences or what readers should understand beyond the measurement.
